poem_en: At sunrise the wind and clouds scatter.
Clear, pure light shines over the world.
The road ahead opens onto a broad highway.
All matters are calm and fortunate; you are kept safe.

Wealth and glory last until old age.
The noble and the common meet in harmony.
All matters are calm and fortunate; do not worry.

poem_en: Success and fame come to you and shine.
The road ahead brings wealth and calm joy.
If a bright round moon shines upon you,
On the fifteenth it is full, its light filling the sky.
sticks.summary: A time when success is complete. Everything is full, like the full moon.

poem_en: Why must you ask about sacred traces?
Within your own heart, you already have what benefits you.
For now, watch the middle of the month.
Misfortune passes and turns to good.
sticks.summary: The answer is already in your own heart. You do not need to depend on outside things. Wait a little longer, and bad matters will turn good.

poem_en: Matters in this world are not yet in harmony.
Clouds cover the moonlight, leaving it hazy.
In your heart you wish to go forward,
But I fear your fate's fortune is not yet open.
sticks.summary: The situation is still unclear and luck is not yet on your side. Wait for the clouds and mist to pass before you act.

poem_en: Though there are many words, do not follow them.
Where wind and clouds are still, no dragon has moved.
Out of the dark, clear news will finally come.
Why must you ask again and again?
sticks.summary: Do not be led by what many people say. For now it is a time of quiet waiting. The answer will come on its own without asking again.

poem_en: Before the Buddha you vowed, with an undivided heart.
Watch the road ahead; good news will come.
This thing was originally iron,
Yet it can change and become gold.
sticks.summary: A sincere, unchanging resolve will turn ordinary things into something valuable. Good news is on its way.

poem_en: East, west, south, north: none is fit to travel.
But what lies ahead you can handle.
I urge you to hold firm and not worry.
Your household has its own protection and wellbeing.
sticks.summary: Going far is not convenient yet, but what is in front of you can be handled. Stay firm and take good care of home.

There is no need to worry and fret.
If you ask whether it will be slow or fast,

sticks.summary: Do not worry about the result. An important opportunity is about to arrive soon.

poem_en: I see you come to ask about what is in your heart.
A household that gathers good deeds has joy to spare.
Fortune is smooth; wealth and children arrive together.

poem_en: A lone lamp, quiet and still, the night deep.
All matters are calm and fortunate; all succeed.
If good fruit comes from what is done unseen,
Burn good incense and it reaches the divine.
sticks.summary: Though this time may feel lonely, good done in secret will bear fruit, and all matters will succeed.

poem_en: You should know that advancing and retreating are all empty talk.
It still looks dim, and not yet whole.
Pearls and jade lie hidden and have not yet changed.
Hoping in your heart brings nothing yet.

poem_en: Though illness weighs on your heart,
